title: Machine Learning Fundamentals
tagline: Supervised learning, loss functions, generalisation, regularisation and evaluation
summary: Before neural networks come the ideas that govern all of machine learning: learning a function from examples, choosing a loss, fitting by optimisation and making sure the result generalises. This course develops them with linear and logistic regression, evaluation metrics and the bias–variance trade-off.

overview: ML fundamentals cover supervised learning, generalization, bias-variance, and model evaluation. This course provides the conceptual foundations for understanding LLMs.
The key insight is that LLMs generalize via scale, but the underlying learning principles remain the same.
outcomes: Explain supervised learning and loss functions.
Describe the bias-variance trade-off and overfitting.
Analyze generalization and the double descent phenomenon.
Evaluate model selection and cross-validation methods.
